answer: A payout is split which means 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The hollow schedule is applied in delta and grove exposes each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4398 identities would post 3380 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
